title: Korean Wholesome Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious pilaf dish inspired by Korean cuisine, made with wholesome ingredients and a hint of sweetness from the pear.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of wholesome oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the diced pear and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf and pear are well combined.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of wholesome oil.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onion if desired.
